═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                          WILLIAM YIJIANG LI
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Hi! I am William Yijiang Li, a 2nd-year PhD student in Machine Learning and Data Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering at [UC San Diego](https://ucsd.edu/), supported by the Jacobs Fellowship.

My research focuses on enabling **efficient** learning (label- [ICCV 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2023/papers/Li_Diverse_Cotraining_Makes_Strong_Semi-Supervised_Segmentor_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf), [CVPR 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2023/papers/Wang_Consistent-Teacher_Towards_Reducing_Inconsistent_Pseudo-Targets_in_Semi-Supervised_Object_Detection_CVPR_2023_paper.pdf); sample- efficiency [AAAI 25](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/32978), [ICCV 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.18531); and synthetic data [ICML 26](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10388)) and **robust** learning ([ICCV 23](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/ICCV2023/papers/Huang_Multi-Metrics_Adaptively_Identifies_Backdoors_in_Federated_Learning_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf), [TMLR](https://openreview.net/forum?id=hafnY2PiTn)) in **multi-modal** ([ICLR 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.02155), [ICCV 25](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.16156)), **interactive and 3D embodied** environments. In particular, I am interested in:
1. Understanding and evaluating multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), e.g. [core knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10855).
2. Can language (in nature semantic, abstract and compositional) be used to scaffold vision learning, e.g. as an anchor representation?
3. Intrinsic 3D world: 3D-aware architectures for MLLMs, 3D representation emergence from 2D supervision, etc.
4. Embodiment theory, learning with indirect feedback (usually in social scenarios) and interactive learning (learn and infer simultaneously).

I am also broadly interested in the various applications of AI, e.g. LLM agents ([MAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.07461)), AI4Sci and AI4Health.

I earned my M.S.E. in Computer Science at [Johns Hopkins University](https://www.jhu.edu/) and my B.E. in Computer Science at South China University of Technology. I have had the privilege of working with Prof. [Alan Yuille](https://www.cs.jhu.edu/~ayuille/) as a research assistant in [CCVL](https://ccvl.jhu.edu/), and with Prof. [Haohan Wang](https://haohanwang.github.io/) at [DREAM Lab](https://dreamlabuiuc.github.io/), UIUC. I have spent time as a research intern at the [Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence](https://www.baai.ac.cn/en/) and [SenseTime Research](https://www.sensetime.com/en).

I co-founded [GrowAI](https://growing-ai-like-a-child.github.io/), a research organization and community aiming to promote the research of AI that can learn and grow like humans.
